user.title: Create Notification Catalog
user.description: A catalog holds your LED notifications. Each notification defines what it means, what it looks like, and which lights show it. Give the catalog a name; you'll add notifications next.

init.description: Add, modify or delete notifications in this catalog.

add.title: Add Notification
add.description: Define a new LED notification. Duration 0 with a state source follows that entity automatically; duration 0 without one creates a manual switch. Duration > 0 creates a momentary button. Prefer target areas or light groups so the notification keeps working as switches are added.

modify_form.title: Edit Notification
modify_form.description: Renaming changes the display name only; the entity ID stays the same so existing automations keep working.

error.name_exists: A notification with this name already exists.
error.state_source_requires_zero_duration: A notification with a state source must have duration 0.
